verdict.rationale: BugSnag documents source-map support for de-minifying JavaScript stack traces (bugsnag-docs-11). It also ships an official CLI that uploads files to improve stacktraces and creates builds and releases (bugsnag-docs-45, bugsnag-docs-12, bugsnag-probe-4), which covers the core CLI-upload path. missing for 10: an explicit statement that the CLI uploads JavaScript source maps specifically, bundler-plugin (webpack/Vite) upload evidence, CI-pipeline usage docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
